collection: Squarespace Commerce Collection (Products, filtered to a Merch category)
note: Real: the site's Merch section shows black apparel (tee, long sleeve, cap, beanie) carrying the green Impound wordmark — no per-item price was shown on screen, so this intentionally omits price rather than inventing one. Rendered here as individual CSS clip-path silhouettes with cursor tilt + idle float (css/interactions.css .merch-shape-*), not a plain image grid; `shape` picks which clip-path (tee/long-sleeve/cap/beanie). Falls back to a plain product image grid with zero code changes if the silhouette treatment isn't wanted. If real pricing should show per item, add a `price` field and swap js/content-loader.js's merchTile() for shopCard()'s pattern.
